title: Eldritch Coin God
description: A surreal dark deity with a crowned black mask and multiple arms sits atop a massive pile of coins and treasures. Hooded cultists worship from below while open books labeled 'Shadow Carapace' and 'Ring of Ruin' float beside the figure amid glowing orbs, spiders, and swirling smoke.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene of a multi-armed eldritch deity wearing a black mask and golden crown with glowing rings, sitting atop a giant pile of coins and treasure. Hooded cultists in robes worship at the base holding candles, floating books titled Shadow Carapace and Ring of Ruin, spiders crawling through smoky atmosphere with glowing golden orbs and particles, intricate detailed linework with high contrast black and gold color scheme
